title: Asian Beef – Raclette with an Asian Twist
method: Whisk garlic, brown sugar, chili powder, pear juice, and oil in a bowl. Add meat and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Cut the vegetables, sprinkle with a little oil.
Slice the bread and the cheese.
Grill the meat and vegetables on the preheated grill top; melt the cheese in the dishes. Combine on your plate. Season with a little paprika and fresh ground black pepper. Enjoy!
